summary: Run hosted Workspace CI after merging an exact queue entry that skipped work using signed evidence

rules.detail: Main upkeep checks the exact queue run attempt's successful evidence-skip markers. Any skipped lane requests the full hosted workflow at the landed SHA; push-context evidence gates cannot skip again.

compatibility.detail: Hosted-tested queue entries retain their checks without duplicate workspace execution. Queue evidence reuse remains disabled by default.

manual.detail: A failed or cancelled post-merge proof reports red main and requests a human revert; no automatic revert occurs.

recovery.detail: Every main push retains its own proof run instead of coalescing pending pushes. Leave merge_group mode off until this workflow is deployed.
